**Week:** wx (also add the `w1` / `w2` / `w3` label and the `PY-Wx` milestone)
**Reviewer:** Member M - <name> (@<reviewer-username>)

## Exercises

- [ ] Wx-1 ...
- [ ] Wx-2 ...
- [ ] Wx-3 ...
- [ ] Wx-4 (variant N) ...

## Done when

- [ ] One branch, at least one meaningful commit per exercise
- [ ] `pytest -q tests/test_wx.py --member <github-username> --variant N` passes with no skips
- [ ] `ruff check members/<github-username>` is clean
- [ ] PR opened with `Closes #<this issue>`, reviewer requested
- [ ] AI use (if any) recorded in `docs/ai-use-log.md` and the PR
- [ ] Own row in `PROGRESS.md` updated with links, test result and actual hours
